maya (PM): Quick proposal: 'launch-stabilize' mini-playbook for days 0-3. Short rules so eng knows what to hotfix vs schedule. Posting draft for quick thumbs.

liam (ENG): Looks useful. Can we keep two daily triages (11:30 & 16:30) and one emergency page?

sana (Support): Please include a 3-line ticket template; support will use it.

drew (SRE): Severity buckets suggestion:
- Sev0: outage or data loss -> page, immediate hotpatch
- Sev1: core flow broken for multiple customers -> target 48h hotfix or canary
- Sev2: degraded with workaround -> schedule in weekly batch
- Sev3: polish/enhancement -> backlog

paul (ProdOps): Rollout guideline: Sev0 -> immediate rollback/hotfix; Sev1 -> canary 5% for 15m then ramp; Sev2 -> group weekly.

yumi (Design): For UI regressions tag 'core-path' if signup/auth/billing affected. Require screenshot + minimal repro for Sev1. Tiny CSS fixes ok.

liam (ENG): Fastlane process: label launch-stab:sev0|1|2|3, attach repro/logs, tag fastlane for Sev0/1 -> 2 reviewers in 6h. Canary rule in PR checklist.

sana (Support): Ticket template I'll use:
Steps to reproduce:
Customers affected (estimate):
App/version/region:
Screenshot/logs:

triage-bot: Created rule LS-Auto to draft issues when two similar support tickets appear in 6h.

maya (PM): Action items: paul create lane and rota (today), liam draft PR fastlane checklist (tomorrow AM), drew add canary/runbook rules (today), yumi publish UI repro checklist (EOD), sana start using template now. I'll run a 10-min walkthrough tomorrow.

liam (ENG): tiny automation snippet (pseudo):
# pseudo
support-bot create-issue --body @support-template && support-bot tag --add launch-stab:sev1

maya (PM): If no objections I'll pin and run walkthrough. :rocket:
